texture.note: halo=0 is an exact same-size pass-through; halo>=2 diverges

interpretation: Guide values and their texture round-trip are exact, but rmAdvancedBandV1 output still depends on the extent of its image inputs. The kernel is same-coordinate and its ROI callback is identity, so this is Core Image's internal tiling of the band graph, not the kernel math. A byte-exact windowed advanced-detail operator therefore requires owning the band composition as well, not only the guide freeze.
